name: package-contract
description: Use this skill when a node package being written needs server-side Python, such as a heavy transform or a library with no browser equivalent. It gives the one backend contract a package follows: the manifest's backend entry, handlers, timeout classes and permissions, the payload a handler gets, the lazy imports of declared dependencies, the sandbox's limits, and what to report as a finding instead of writing it.
